# THE COMPOSITION — order-bias-probe's opening route (keikaku, 2026-11-24)

The opening whole: 5 stages, 4 gates, 3 increments, 8 ungated placements. THE MEASUREMENT FIRST, THE CURE EARNED BY THE DATUM, THE NULL A FINDING (the convening ruling, Q-order-bias) — the stages measure before any cure; the build set is named NOT pinned, ruled by the datum's outcome at its own gate. The census is placed FIRST; NONE of its findings is assumed by this composition (the census-first law, carried standing). Every seat placed.

## THE STAGES

**census** — THE CENSUS FIRST (the statistical cycle's opening, R7's deferral revisited): FOUR ungated legs over the tree's own ground — tansa's vote-corpus census (the runs on disk, the stamped votes whole: comparator_id, comparator_class, the pair, the winner, the recorded_at; the counts by run and class; the corroboration floor's citable classes), shindan's honest-condition diagnosis (what the corpus can and cannot support), rikai's mechanism maps (the tally's counting, the scheduler's canonical order, the seed's shuffle seam), keisan's statistical arithmetic (the forms' power at the corpus's size, the thresholds, the both-orders sample sizes) — THE CLAIMS LANE riding every leg (Wang et al. VERIFIED at the birth store, B3 CONFIRMED; any fresh claim its own verdict). ENTRY: G-COMPOSITION is green; the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

**design** — THE DESIGN LANE + THE DESIGN GATE: THREE ungated legs over the census's findings (suisen's measurement recommendation; hyoka's adversarial pass — the statistical honesty attacked; moho's datum-story walk — the measured record walked cold) + togo's gated synthesis closing G-PROBE-DESIGN — the collaborator's ruling on the full record: the measurement's shape judged publicly right. ENTRY: the census legs landed (the corpus counted, the conditions diagnosed, the mechanisms mapped, the arithmetic priced); the design fires over the census's findings.

**measure** — THE MEASUREMENT (the datum over the tree's own data): the probe instrument built per the approved design (the exact-task law; jikko, per-step per R8's file-unit), the measurement run per the design's ruled composition (the corpus read and/or the experiment minted — the same pairs presented both orders, the bench's own hands, nothing paid), the measured record landed at the store's build home (the datum at its own weight, never smoothed), kensho's independent re-run (the read-back the evidence); the increment closes G-DATUM — the datum's own gate. ENTRY: G-PROBE-DESIGN is green — the design is the spec; the measurement runs only per the approved shape (the measurement-first mandate).

**cure** — THE BUILD SET (earned by the datum, named not pinned): the LIKELY SET — the both-orders averaging at the tally, the presentation-shuffle mode the scheduler's seed already carries (the additive widening, R7's own fence), the early-stop rules — the DATUM rules the set and each unit's shape; the two-lane brief→spec→build per earned unit, one file per dispatch (R8), each landing per its approved spec (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALK at any user-facing unit (R4), one-commit-per-increment. ENTRY: G-DATUM has ruled the cure FIRES — the build set earned by the datum's outcome; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law). IF THE NULL STANDS: the stage stands empty by the datum's own ruling — the finding the record, the honest statement carried; the route walks to the close.

**close** — THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry — the datum or the null named honestly at its own weight; the next era named — outward/PyPI the inward lane's remainder, the banked triggers carried), the done call at the collaborator's ruling. ENTRY: the route's live gates closed (G-DATUM the last — fired or null) and the collaborator has called the close.

## THE GATES

**G-COMPOSITION** (collaborator-ruling) — THE HEAD:
1. the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: stages, gates, increments, the ungated placements, the load-bearing decisions) — the opening whole, the census placed FIRST with none of its findings assumed, every seat placed
2. every choice cites its ruling: the convening ruling's three halves (the measurement first; the cure earned by the datum; the null a finding, never a failure) + R3's inward direction (auth DONE, the probe second) + R7's priced deferral (Wang et al.'s flips-on-swap, the presentation_order datum, the seed carried for the additive widening) + the auth close's verified-stamps ground + the standing laws (R6/R11 the seat-authored report, R8 the file-unit, the two-lane, R4 the walk, the claims lane, the census-first, the free-tier spirit)

**G-CLOSE** (collaborator-ruling):
1. hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named
2. the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the datum or the null named honestly at its own weight; the cure's landing state named if fired); the next era named (outward/PyPI the inward lane's remainder; the >100-item scale fence held, the banked triggers carried)

The per-unit gates mint at their turns (NONE pre-pinned): G-<UNIT>-BRIEF (the unit-brief lane, auto-stamped at the build-add) + G-<UNITSPEC>-BRIEF (the exact-task bytes at synthesis — FR-MEM-0011's doctrine) + G-<UNIT> (deterministic-check: the floor-green + kensho's independent re-run + moho's walk at any user-facing unit) — the two-lane standing shape over the datum's earned set.

## THE INCREMENTS

- **measure/probe** · owner jikko · gate G-DATUM — steps: [instrument · semantic · jikko · gate], [run · semantic · shinko · gate], [floor-green · deterministic · tool "make dev && make test && make lint && make typecheck at the prioritree root" · gate]

G-COMPOSITION validates this composition (this report the evidence; the outcome recorded against compose/route) → the census fires (four packets, parallel, ungated; the claims lane riding) → the design lane (three packets, ungated, over the census's findings) → togo's synthesis closes G-PROBE-DESIGN (the measurement's shape ruled: the both-directions composition, the form, the threshold, the cost) → the measurement runs per the approved design (the instrument, the run, the record; kensho independent) → G-DATUM rules on the measured record (the cure FIRES — the build set earned — or the NULL STANDS — a finding) → the cure units mint at their build-adds if fired (brief → spec → build; per-step, the file-unit; kensho independent per build gate; moho's walk at user-facing units) → the collaborator calls the close → hansei's retro, the records, the done call.

# census/mechanisms — the judgment chain's mechanism maps: the order's every seam

**Seat:** rikai (理解) · **Packet:** census/mechanisms · **Route:** order-bias-probe (the census stage's third ungated leg) · **Date:** 2026-11-24. **Read-only held** — this report the only write.

**Ground read whole:** the store's heart (.junro/junro.json — the census stage's four parallel ungated packets, the convening ruling, G-PROBE-DESIGN's scope-fence condition); the birth store's R7 leg (understand/scheduler.md — the seed's fence doctrine at :49, the canonical pair form's seam); the auth build whole (key_store.py, key_verify.py, service.py's stamping). **The mechanism files whole:** scheduler.py, session.py, service_store.py, service.py, web.py + pair.html, mcp_server.py, cli.py, votes.py, tally.py, registry.py (the verdict vocabulary), run_store.py (the persisted line, the load). **Fail-fast check: no ground missing.** Every claim below cites file:line; the tree is the truth.

## MAP 1 — THE SCHEDULER'S PRESENTATION FORM (where the order is born)

- **The canonical pair.** `Pair` — a frozen two-string dataclass, fields `item_a`/`item_b`, the canonical invariant **item_a < item_b STRICT** (ids distinct per the registry's upstream duplicate refusal, so no equal pair can arise) — scheduler.py:27-49, the invariant at :43-45. Hashable by construction (load-bearing for the dedup keys and the counts maps, :35-37).
- **The sort's law.** `schedule_pairs(ids, seed=None)` sorts the ids lexicographically — Python codepoint order, no locale, no case-folding — **the sort IS the stability mechanism**, making enumeration a pure function of the SET (scheduler.py:80, the law at :55-58). The seven runs span six different questions over five item universes (beauty, colors, "Which", snacks, the 401-vs-hide findings, the-told-vs-the-lived) — heterogeneous, incommensurable content. Effectively ~2 humans + 1 llm: the votes cluster within comparators; any aggregate rate estimates THESE comparators, never the CLASSES; no between-comparator variance exists within a class.
(c) THE RUN CONFOUND: class is confounded with run and content domain — the human-only runs judged colors and "Which" (rows 1-13); the llm-only runs judged snacks and the R4 findings (rows 14-20); the single mixed pair is itself an instrument check (rows 21-22). ## 1. THE RETROSPECTIVE DATUM'S FORMS (the descriptive statistics + the exact test at the real N)

1.1 The position-preference rate (prefer-a's share among non-tie votes): 12/22 = 0.5455 (54.5%). Human slice: 7/14 = 0.5000. LLM slice: 5/8 = 0.6250.

1.2 The exact binomial test at N=22 (H0: first-position share w = 0.5), observed 12: one-sided tail P(X≥12) = [Σ C(22,k), k=12..22]/2^22 = 1744436/4194304 = 0.41591 → two-sided p = 2 × 0.41591 = 0.8318. THE DATUM SITS AT THE NULL'S HEART (12 is one vote above the mean 11).

1.3 The test's rejection bar at α=0.05 (exact two-sided): X=16 → p = 2 × 110056/4194304 = 0.05248 (misses); X=17 → p = 2 × 35443/4194304 = 0.01690 (rejects). The corpus rejects ONLY at ≥17/22 = 77.3% first-position share (or ≤5/22).

1.4 The 95% Wilson CI at 12/22: inner term 0.5455×0.4545/22 + 1.96²/(4×22²) = 0.011270 + 0.001984 = 0.013254; √ = 0.115128 (verified by its square); half-width = 1.96×0.115128/1.174618 = 0.192112; center = (0.54545+0.087309)/1.174618 = 0.538721 → CI = [0.3466, 0.7308]. WIDTH ±19.2 points (38.4 whole).

1.5 THE POWER LADDER at N=22 (P(reject | w), exact test, terms summed and verified): w=0.60 → 0.072 (7%); w=0.65 → 0.163 (16%); w=0.70 → 0.314 (31%); w=0.75 → 0.517 (52%); w=0.80 → 0.733 (73%); w=0.825 → 0.826 (83%). MDE at 80% power ≈ w = 0.82: the corpus is 80%-powered ONLY for a ≥32-point position capture.

1.6 THE PER-CLASS SLICES' OWN POWER: human N=14 (bar 12/14 = 85.7%): power at w=0.75 = 0.281, at w=0.825 = 0.546, MDE₈₀ ≈ 0.88. LLM N=8 (bar 8/8 = 100% — nothing less rejects): power at 0.75 = 0.75⁸ = 0.100, at 0.825 = 0.825⁸ = 0.215 (verified 0.463251² = 0.21460), MDE₈₀ = 0.8^(1/8) ≈ 0.97. NO SLICE ALONE CAN CATCH EVEN THE GROSS CLASS; only the pooled N=22 does.

1.7 THE TIE RATE'S SEPARATE DATUM (its own weight): 0/22 = 0.000; the 95% upper bound (the rule of three) = 3/22 = 0.136 (13.6%). No tie evidence exists; ties excluded from the position test exclude nothing here (the non-tie N IS 22).

1.8 THE HONEST STATEMENT OF THE RETROSPECTIVE NULL: the corpus's datum 54.5% [34.7%, 73.1%] EXCLUDES (at 95%) any first-position share above 0.731 — the ONE bound it carries: if the tree's judges captured position at the verified literature-gross rate (0.825), the corpus would likely have shown it (power 83%). THE STRONG-BF DISCIPLINE PRICES ≈ +50% N over α=0.05 at the same effect.

3.3 THE MULTIPLE-COMPARISONS HONEST FORM: 3 confirmatory tests demand Bonferroni (+33.4% each); the cheaper honest form — ONE pre-registered primary (the pooled flip asymmetry at α=0.05) + the class slices EXPLORATORY (at the corpus's own N the slices are powerless anyway: §1.6).

3.4 THE NULL'S WEIGHT AT THIS POWER: a null at N=22 bounds NOTHING below 0.731 (§1.8). A null at the bench-feasible designs bounds |θ−0.5| only within ~±0.25 (gross design, m≈6-8 discordants) to ~±0.20 (half design, m≈24: half-width ≈ 1.96·√(0.25/24) = 0.20). The equivalence form (±0.10) costs ~97 discordants — 4× the half design. THE DESIGN GATE MUST RULE WHICH BOUND THE NULL CARRIES: "no gross hack-class bias" (cheap) vs "the flip asymmetry is under ±10 points" (~1,000-1,550 votes).

## 4. THE CURE'S PRICES (named not pinned — the datum rules; each priced at $0 and at the cost the datum would justify)

4.1 BOTH-ORDERS AVERAGING (Wang's own cure — "Balanced Position Calibration"): THE STRUCTURAL FACT — the CURRENT tally already averages implicitly: a flip pair nets one win to each item (a 0.5-0.5), a consistent pair nets 2-0 — the win-rate count IS the both-orders average; NO tally change (the purity and R12's byte-identity untouched). THE REAL PRICE: (a) the write path's presented→canonical mapping (votes.py's cast_vote seam: the vote surface gains the presented pair or a presentation flag, mapped onto the canonical Pair at write) + (b) THE SCHEMA'S PRESENTATION DATUM (a presentation_order field on the vote record — non-optional per the prior-art's own field schema; the corpus's records carry none — the datum must be carried to be measurable) + (c) THE VOLUME: 2× at every sitting (RUN-0002's 10-vote sitting becomes 20; at n=100 the full both-orders both-class sweep = 100×99×2 = 19,800 votes). At $0 the bench's hands absorb it at small n; the cost the datum justifies: a measured asymmetric flip datum (φ>0, θ>0.5 — Wang's verified class justifies the double outright; a null at the honest bound does NOT — the deferral stands).

4.2 THE SHUFFLE MODE (the scheduler's seed already carried): the seam EXISTS — schedule_pairs(ids, seed=None) (scheduler.py:52, the reserved parameter) + derive_seed(run_id) (blake2b, :87). THE ADDITION'S PRICE: a seeded per-pair presentation draw (the seed consumed — the widening additive, never rework) + the same write-path mapping and schema field as 4.1. THE VOLUME PRICE: $0 — NO extra votes. THE HONEST LIMIT: the shuffle debiases IN EXPECTATION (E[first-position capture] = 0.5 by symmetry) — it converts systematic bias into run-level noise; it does NOT cancel per-pair (a small run's realized orders are unbalanced with probability 1). The purity held: the manifest carries the seed, the schedule stays a pure function of (ids, seed) — byte-identical replays preserved. Justified by: ANY measured position sensitivity — the cheapest cure (no volume, one seam, one field).

4.3 THE EARLY-STOP RULES (the adaptive form — the >100-item fence held): the price: a scheduler-side STOP CONSUMER over the tally's coverage datum (pair_counts / the running flip count — the stop is never a tally input; the tally's purity preserved) + THE SEQUENTIAL DISCIPLINE: repeated looks inflate α — the honest forms a pre-registered boundary (Pocock / O'Brien-Fleming) or the SPRT; the >100-item fence held (the stop rule operates WITHIN the ruled small-n scope, never widening it). THE VALUE: at gross effects the sequential form stops at ~6-10 discordants vs the fixed design's 24 — a 30-50% vote saving; at the null it confirms the bound cheaper. Justified by: any measured φ (the boundary's information form) or the budget-curve precedent's own efficiency demand.

## 5. THE HEADLINE FOR THE DESIGN GATE (the arithmetic whole)

- THE RETROSPECTIVE: the corpus's first-position share 12/22 = 54.5% [34.7, 73.1], exact p = 0.832 — null-ish; 80%-powered ONLY at w ≥ 0.82; the class slices (N=14, N=8) are powerless even at the gross class (55%/21%); the ONE bound carried: the verified Wang-gross rate (0.825) is excluded in the corpus's own content; the 23-point band below it is blind; the id-sort confound and the ZERO both-order units mean the retrospective form can never support the causal claim.
- THE PROSPECTIVE: the both-orders causal design at the corroboration floor (4 votes/pair) prices at 44 votes (Wang-gross), 216 (half), 856 (modest), 12,600 (null-ish); the honest ±10-point null costs ~97 discordants (~970-1,552 votes); the bench's own hands (≈13 llm seats + 1 human, $0) afford the gross and half classes, NOT the modest/null.
- THE THRESHOLD: 0.05 = 7.849; 0.01 = +48.8%; Bonferroni-3 = +33.4%; strong-BF ≈ +50%; the honest pre-registration: one primary + exploratory slices; the null's weight must be ruled as a BOUND (which bound the design can afford).
- THE CURES: both-orders averaging = write-path mapping + presentation field + 2× volume (the tally untouched — the count already averages); the shuffle = the carried seed seam + the same field, $0 volume, expectation-level debiasing; the early-stop = a scheduler stop consumer + a pre-registered sequential boundary, the fence held.

# suisen (推薦) — THE CALCULATE EXPANSION ASSESSED FOR HIKARI: the op manifest, the provenance schema, the numerics policy, the priorities

Packet recommend/calc-ops · Route order-bias-probe · Q-calc-expansion · 2026-11-24. A RECOMMENDATION, NEVER A COMPUTATION — no number below is my product; every form cites the ground on disk (the convening ruling at the store's junro.json; the engine .opencode/scripts/calculate.py whole; the wrapper .opencode/tools/calculate.ts whole; the pin pyproject.toml >=3.13; reports/census/statistical-arithmetic.md and honest-conditions.md; FR-MEM-0036/0037; src/prioritree/scheduler.py:87-106 the derive_seed precedent). Every proposal pairs its recommendation with the reasoning.

## 0. THE LIVE EVIDENCE FOR THE PROVENANCE LAW, NAMED FIRST (it shapes the whole manifest)

My own recomputation (a recommendation's check, named as such — the instrument owes the settlement): the two census legs' Wilson-95 bounds at the SAME 12/22 DISAGREE — keisan §1.4: [0.3466, 0.7308]; shindan §2: [31.3%, 76.4%]. The disagreement is a DROPPED NORMALIZER: shindan's half-width omits the (1+z²/n) divisor (center 0.5387 ± 0.2257 unnormalized = [0.3131, 0.7644]; the correct 0.5387 ± 0.1921 = [0.3466, 0.7308]). Two legs, one quantity, two answers — and the record as it stands cannot settle which: neither leg carries an instrument trace to appeal to. That is FR-MEM-0036's fault made concrete: the trace must be INSEPARABLE from the number (§2), and the arithmetic must run at the instrument (§5's re-fire). The manifest below is built so this class of error cannot recur silently.

## 1. THE OP MANIFEST, TIERED

Each op: name / signature / semantics / stdlib backing / refusal domain (the ThreePart triggers) / consumers. EVERY op is stdlib-carried (the free-tier law: pyproject's dependencies untouched — math, statistics, random, hashlib only; the 3.13 pin carries math.comb/lgamma/sqrt/log/exp, statistics.NormalDist/median/fmean/pstdev/stdev/pvariance/variance, all from 3.8 or earlier). All-op grammar: fixed-argv --flag=value; EVERY operand explicit and required (a hidden default is an untraceable operand — no defaults anywhere in the new surface).

### TIER 1 — THE PROBE-UNBLOCKING ATOMS (first to land; the held verification's demands)

1. **sqrt** — `sqrt --a` — √a — math.sqrt — REFUSES a<0 (negative radicand: no real root; complex is outside the type contract) — consumers: the Wilson radical (§1.4), the half-width atoms (§3.4's 1.96·√(0.25/24)), the df=1 χ² p chain. The op keisan's census lacked — "the square roots verified by their squares (the tool's six ops carry no sqrt)": the detour this op kills.
2. **power** — `power --a --b` — a^b, b real (a², 0.825⁸, 2^24, 0.8^(1/8): one op; int bases keep exact int) — the ** operator (int exact / float64) — REFUSES 0^b for b≤0 (0^0 indeterminate; 0^negative is 1/0), unrepresentable results (the inf-guard) — consumers: the threshold constants (1.96+0.8416)²=7.849, (2.5758+0.8416)²=11.679, (2.394+0.8416)²=10.469 (§3.1); Wilson's z²; the ladder's 0.75⁸/0.825⁸ (§1.6); the MDE 0.8^(1/8); the BF's 2^m; the equivalence m = 1.96²×0.25/0.01.
3. **factorial** — `factorial --n` — n! EXACT INT, arbitrary precision — math.factorial — REFUSES non-integer n, n<0 — consumers: the binomial exact chains, the BF's Beta(k+1, m−k+1) = k!(m−k)!/(m+1)! form. THE NAMED BOUNDARY (docstring-carried): float64 overflows at 171! (170!≈7.26e306 fits; 171!>1.80e308) — the ENGINE's int is unbounded; the boundary rides any downstream float CONVERSION, never the op.
4. **combination** — `combination --n --k` — C(n,k) exact int — math.comb — REFUSES non-integers, n<0, k<0, k>n — consumers: the exact binomial's Σ C(22,k) (§1.2/§1.3), every sign-test tail, the BF chain.
5. **proportion** — `proportion --part --whole` — part/whole (the share form; percentage = proportion × 100 stepwise via the existing multiply — the composition's two citable traces beat one sugar op) — divide beneath — REFUSES whole=0 (division by zero), non-numeric — consumers: the position-share 12/22, the class shares 14/22 and 8/22, the slices 7/14 and 5/8, the rule-of-three 3/22 (§1.7), votes-per-pair 22/21.
6. **mean** — `mean --values` — the arithmetic mean — statistics.fmean — REFUSES empty array, non-numeric elements — consumers: the pace atoms (7.9 s/vote, 1.77 s/vote), votes-per-pair.
7. **variance** — `variance --values --form=population|sample` — statistics.pvariance / statistics.variance — REFUSES empty; the sample form at n<2 (the zero-denominator class) — consumers: the dispersion atoms behind the CI half-widths.
8. **stddev** — `stddev --values --form=population|sample` — statistics.pstdev / statistics.stdev — same refusals — consumers: the ±-point half-widths; derivable from variance+sqrt but carried directly (the cited quantity, one trace).
9. **max** / 10. **min** — `max --values` / `min --values` — REFUSES empty (no extremum of nothing) — consumers: the ladder's bounds, the pace extremes.
11. **median** — `median --values` — statistics.median — REFUSES empty, non-numeric — consumers: the sittings' central pace, robust centers.
12. **quantile** — `quantile --values --p` — the p-quantile by FIXED (n−1)-based linear interpolation (the method NAMED in the docstring — determinism demands one method, never a flag) — sorted-array arithmetic — REFUSES empty, p outside [0,1] — consumers: the quartile atoms, the datum's tails.
13. **wilson** — `wilson --k --n --z` — the Wilson score interval: p̂=k/n; d=1+z²/n; center=(p̂+z²/(2n))/d; half=z·√(p̂(1−p̂)/n + z²/(4n²))/d; RESULT the pair [lo, hi] — math.sqrt — REFUSES non-integer k, k<0, n≤0, k>n, z≤0 — consumers: §1.4's 12/22 → [0.3466, 0.7308]; the class slices (7/14, 5/8); the prospective datum's bounds (honest-conditions §4's 2-flip [0.3%, 30.0%]); §0's discrepancy settled by construction (the instrument computes, the seat quotes). The z-explicit form ruled over --confidence sugar: every constant appears in the trace, nothing resolved invisibly.
14. **binom-test** — `binom-test --k --n --p --sided=two|one` — the EXACT binomial p: at p=0.5 in arbitrary-precision INTS (Σ C(n,j)/2^n, the final division the only float — keisan's 1744436/4194304 form preserved exactly); at general p in float terms (each ≤1, the sum ≤1 — no overflow; tail underflow contributes 0); two-sided = 2·min(tail) capped at 1 — math.comb + int arithmetic — REFUSES non-integer k/n, k<0, n<0, k>n, p outside [0,1] — consumers: THE SIGN TEST (§1.2: 12/22 two-sided ≈0.8318; §1.3's bar: 17/22 rejects, 16/22 misses); THE POWER LADDER (§1.5: power at w = the one-sided tail at the bar — P(X≥17|0.75) is this op at p=0.75); the per-class bars (§1.6); the prospective sign test among flips (§2.3: 2·0.5⁶=0.03125). The COMPOSITE ruled in (not just atoms) because its interior — the tail sum, the min, the cap, the ×2 — is exactly where seat-side transcription errors enter (§0 is the proof).

### TIER 2 — THE MEASUREMENT CLASS'S STEADY DIET (lands with/before the design gate's threshold ruling)

15. **normal-cdf** — `normal-cdf --x` — Φ(x) — statistics.NormalDist().cdf — total (no domain refusals; non-numeric only) — consumers: the df=1 χ² p chain (p = 2(1−Φ(√χ²))), the tail atoms.
16. **normal-ppf** — `normal-ppf --q` — Φ⁻¹(q) — statistics.NormalDist().inv_cdf — REFUSES q outside (0,1) (q∈{0,1} → ±∞: the range refusal) — consumers: THE THRESHOLD TABLE'S Z CONSTANTS — 1.96=ppf(0.975), 0.8416=ppf(0.80), 2.5758=ppf(0.995), the Bonferroni-3 2.394=ppf(1−0.05/6) (§3.1); every power/sample arithmetic's z² atoms. A mistyped 2.394 is a silent wrong threshold; an envelope-carried operand is quotable.
17. **log** — `log --a` — ln(a) (any base stepwise: log(a)/log(b)) — math.log — REFUSES a≤0 (the log domain) — consumers: the BF chain's m·ln2, the log-space front door.
18. **exp** — `exp --a` — e^a — math.exp — REFUSES unrepresentable (e^710 overflows float64: the inf-guard) — consumers: the log-space chains' return step.
19. **log-factorial** — `log-factorial --n` — ln(n!) = math.lgamma(n+1) — REFUSES non-integer, n<0 — consumers: the large-m chains past the 171! float boundary.
20. **log-combination** — `log-combination --n --k` — ln C(n,k) = lgamma(n+1)−lgamma(k+1)−lgamma(n−k+1) — REFUSES the combination domain — consumers: the far-ladder general-p chains (the null-ish class), if ever run.
21. **log-beta** — `log-beta --a --b` — ln B(a,b) = lgamma(a)+lgamma(b)−lgamma(a+b) — REFUSES a≤0, b≤0 — consumers: THE BF FORM (§3.2: log BF₁₀ = log-beta(k+1, m−k+1) + m·ln 2, then exp) — the threshold table's strong-BF option priced honestly at the design gate.
22. **chisquare** — `chisquare --observed --expected` (equal-length JSON arrays) — the goodness-of-fit statistic χ² = Σ(O−E)²/E and its df (len−1); RESULT the pair [χ², df] — the sum/power/divide atoms — REFUSES length mismatch, empty, any E≤0 cell, non-numeric — consumers: the class-balance questions (the 14/8 mix). THE HONEST LIMIT (docstring-carried): the χ² p-VALUE at df>1 is NOT stdlib-carried (incomplete-gamma machinery) — the op emits the statistic; the df=1 p composes stepwise (√ → normal-cdf → complement → ×2, all citable); df>1 rides the ruled critical-value table, NEVER a silent approximation.
23. **shuffle** — `shuffle --values --seed` — the deterministic permutation under the EXPLICIT integer seed — random.Random(seed).shuffle — the S311 ruled seam precedent (acceptance.py, budget_curve.py: the seeded simulation, stdlib-reproducible) — REFUSES an absent or non-integer seed (DETERMINISM DEMANDS THE OPERAND — the one place entropy could creep, foreclosed by construction), empty array — consumers: the prospective experiment's presentation-draw design (the cure §4.2 priced at the design gate). THE PURITY RULING, ASSESSED HONESTLY: COMPATIBLE — the pure-query law demands same-inputs→same-output, and the seed IS an input; random.Random(seed) is process- and PYTHONHASHSEED-independent (Mersenne Twister, never the builtin hash — the derive_seed docstring's own named trap, scheduler.py:98); cross-version stability is foreclosed by the pin (>=3.13) + the KAT's byte-exact pin. NO RNG-without-seed op exists anywhere in the manifest — this op is the seed's only legal carrier.
24. **derive-seed** — `derive-seed --text` — the stable blake2b digest → int (scheduler.py's own derive_seed form: blake2b, first 8 bytes big-endian) — total (a pure function of its argument) — consumers: the seed's own provenance tool-carried (run_id → seed, the manifest's replay story citable as a trace). Recommended so the shuffle's seed never enters a report as a bare prose constant.

### TIER 3 — THE HONEST BOUNDARY (named, never silent — carried in every op's help text)

- NO SIMULATION/MCMC: any RNG without an explicit seed operand refuses by construction (the shuffle law generalizes); no sampled p-values, no bootstrap, no Monte Carlo — inference is EXACT (integer binomial) or NORMAL-DERIVED (the df=1 chain), never sampled.
- NO REGRESSION SUITES: no OLS/logistic/fitting — the moment the tool fits models it is a statistics library, not a calculator; the probe never demands it.
- NO SCIPY/NUMPY/MPMATH: priced and REFUSED where the stdlib carries the need (every op above is stdlib) — the named refused list: the general χ²/F/t CDFs, kernel densities, optimization, non-central power. A future need wanting them is a PRICED DEPENDENCY RULING at the collaborator — never a silent add.
- NO DATASET INGESTION: flags and JSON arrays only — the tool never reads files, never queries stores.
- NO PROSE OPS: the type contract stands.
- NO MUTATION, EVER; NOT a substitute for kensho's verification — the anti_scenario carried verbatim.
- THE MANIFEST ITSELF IS GOVERNED: the op set grows ONLY at a demonstrated friction entry + the collaborator's ruling — never by forecast.

## 2. THE PROVENANCE LAW MADE STRUCTURAL (FR-MEM-0036/0037)

# THE DATUM STORY PRE-WALKED — moho (design/datum-story, order-bias-probe, 2026-11-25)

The seat: moho (盲歩) — the story walked COLD, before the measurement runs its prospective form. The ground read whole: the four census legs (vote-corpus, honest-conditions, mechanisms, statistical-arithmetic + keisan's verification pass), the store's heart (the convening ruling: the measurement first, the cure earned by the datum, THE NULL A FINDING NEVER A FAILURE, the datum reported at its own weight), the README's own surfaces (Auth at :122-176, the corroboration floor told up front at :172), CONTINUATION.md (the record home), the mcp docstring's positional law (mcp_server.py:517-518). The three headline numbers re-fired at MY OWN instrument (the provenance law held at my own hand): proportion 12/22 → 0.5454545454545454; wilson 12/22/1.96 → [0.34659473289041554, 0.7307998556799515]; binom-test 12/22 → 0.8318119049072266; Wang's gross 66/80 → 0.825; the corrected half-design null's half-width 1.96×√(0.25/35) → 0.16565023392678924 (±16.6 points).

## 1. THE READING PATHS (each possible datum, walked as the reader meets it)

**PATH A — THE GROSS DATUM (the flips-on-swap rate at Wang's verified class, ~0.825 first-position capture; my instrument: 66/80 = 0.825).** The cure fires at G-DATUM. What the honest telling makes the reader understand: "we measured our own judgment surface and found it hackable at the literature's verified gross rate — every single-order ranking this tree ever emitted carried that exposure; the cure is earned and priced." What the telling MUST carry: (a) the datum's scope — measured over the minted experiment's own items and comparators, the classes sliced per the stamps; (b) THE BOTH-ORDERS AVERAGING'S COST TOLD WHOLE — the structural fact first (the current tally ALREADY averages implicitly: a flip pair nets one win to each item, a consistent pair 2-0 — the win-rate count IS the both-orders average; the purity and R12's byte-identity untouched), then the REAL price (the write-path's presented→canonical mapping + the presentation_order field — the seven sites rikai mapped [VoteRecord votes.py:64-72; the persisted line run_store.py:808-819; the wire service.py:181-186; the MCP schema mcp_server.py:159-165; the CLI cli.py:186-193; the web form pair.html:3-13; the tier call sites session.py:240-276] + THE VOLUME: 2× at every sitting — RUN-0002's 10-vote sitting becomes 20); (c) the retrospective corpus NOT dressed as corroboration — the 54.5% descriptor was never a contrast, and a gross prospective datum does not retro-convert it. THE DISHONEST READINGS NAMED: the smoothed telling ("we always knew, this confirms it" — nothing was ever measured before this probe; the deferral's price was precisely that NO datum existed); the cure told as free (the 2× volume and the field's seven sites hidden behind "the tally already averages").

**PATH B — THE MODEST DATUM (~0.6-0.7 first-capture / the flip asymmetry at the margin).** The cure's earn condition at the margin — the story is clear ONLY if the cure's SPLIT is named. The honest telling: the datum lands inside the band the retrospective could never see (the corpus 80%-powered only at ≥0.82; the band below 73.1% blind); the modest class demanded ~960 votes at the corrected ladder (856 → ~960 — keisan's verification) — the bench's stretch, not its comfort. THE CURE'S SPLIT: the shuffle mode is the margin's cure — $0 volume, one seam (the seed already carried, scheduler.py:52), one field, expectation-level debiasing (E[first-capture] = 0.5 by symmetry; it converts systematic bias into run-level noise — it does NOT cancel per-pair); both-orders averaging's 2× volume is justified only by a datum whose cost it beats — at the margin the telling prices BOTH and lets the gate's ruling pick. THE DISHONEST READINGS: smoothed UP ("bias confirmed — full cure") or smoothed DOWN ("basically nothing — no cure") — the same sin at opposite signs; the datum at its own weight is the only cure for both.

**PATH C — THE NULL AT THE REALISTIC N (the finding carried, the deferral's revisit honest).** The honest bound told: "no bias larger than X", NEVER "no bias". The bound is the design's own ruled weight: at the gross design (44 votes) the null excludes only the gross class (power 0.826 at the corpus's own N per keisan's ladder — a capture ≥ the Wang rate would likely have shown); at the corrected half design (m=35 discordants, ~308 votes) the null carries |θ−0.5| within ~±17 points (my instrument: 1.96×√(0.25/35) = 0.16565); the ±10-point equivalence form costs ~97 discordants (~968-1,552 votes — beyond the bench's $0 ceiling). The honest sentence: "the flip asymmetry is bounded under ±X at 95% — the standing canonical presentation measured adequate at the ruled bound; anything smaller is unmeasured, never absent." THE DISHONEST READING NAMED: "no bias found" — the bound-erasing form; the null's only honest claim is the bound it was powered to carry, and the bound must be named IN THE SAME BREATH as the null.

## 2. THE PRODUCT'S OWN TELLING (where the datum's story lives)

- THE AUTH SECTION (README:122-176): the datum does NOT extend it — the probe is not an auth question. The one touch: the datum's provenance line carries the stamps' ERA (§4-3) — the two stories meet at the boundary the caveat names, and neither borrows the other's credibility.
- THE CORROBORATION FLOOR'S TELLING (README:172 — "told up front"): untouched by the datum's outcome — the floor is class coverage, never order; the honest telling does not fold the datum into the floor's paragraph.
- THE NO-ANCHORING DISCIPLINE (web.py:39-41, :446, :717 — the count UNREAD at every sitting): the product that anchors nothing is the same product that must carry its own measured bias honestly — the datum's lane sits BESIDE this discipline. The product that says "we measured our own bias" may NEVER say "we are bias-free" — a claim no bound supports.
- WHERE THE STORY LIVES, RANKED: (1) THE CONTINUATION RECORD — G-CLOSE's own condition names it ("the measured truth carried whole [the datum's verdict and its price]") — the record home, BOTH outcomes; (2) THE RUN'S OWN RECORD at G-DATUM (the raw votes, the statistic, the threshold's comparison — every number citable to its vote); (3) THE README — earned ONLY at the budget-curve precedent's weight (the measured citation: one paragraph, the citation ADDS, never silent, never marketing): if the cure fires with a user-facing surface (the shuffle mode changes what runs.next serves), the telling lands where the user meets it — the mcp docstring's positional law (mcp_server.py:517-518) and the tally's own docs extend to name the presentation divergence; if the null stands, ONE measured sentence in the README's discipline lane citing the record — never a lane built for the null's bound alone; (4) THE SCHEMA'S OWN TELLING: the presentation_order field (rikai's Map 4, seven sites) is the datum's citable bytes — the field the cure mints IS the story the record will carry.

## 3. THE COLD-READ TEST (the verified numbers told three ways — my own trace lines)

- THE BARE SHARE "54.55%": MISLEADS COLD. The reader sees a number above one-half and reads a bias; the share carries no N, no width, no bound, no confound. (Instrument: {"op":"proportion","args":{"part":"12","whole":"22"},"result":0.5454545454545454}.)
- THE INTERVAL FORM "[34.7%, 73.1%] — a coin flip's neighborhood": TEACHES THE TRUTH COLD. The width is IN the number (±19.2 points at N=22 — the interval spans fair by a wide margin), and the upper bound IS the bound story (no capture above 73.1% at this N). One clause short: the interval tells the RETROSPECTIVE datum's weight — without the confound clause it over-reads into the null's claim. (Instrument: {"op":"wilson","args":{"k":"12","n":"22","z":"1.96"},"result":[0.34659473289041554,0.7307998556799515]}.)
- THE P FORM "p=0.83 — no departure from fair": HALF-TEACHES — THE MOST MISREADABLE. The arithmetic is honest ({"op":"binom-test","args":{"k":"12","n":"22","p":"0.5","sided":"two"},"result":0.8318119049072266} — byte-identical to the record's headline) but the p alone hides the width and the bound, and "no departure" is the null-proved-nothing doorway.
- THE RECOMMENDED TELLING: the interval FIRST, the share and N inside it, the bound and the confound in the same breath, the p second and never alone: "12 of 22 first-position wins (54.6%), 95% Wilson [34.7%, 73.1%] — at this corpus's size the share is indistinguishable from fair, and the datum excludes any first-position capture above 73.1%; and because position is collinear with the id-sort (every pair ever judged in exactly one, canonical, direction), even a departure would not be attributable to order — the corpus's descriptor, never a causal datum (exact two-sided p = 0.8318)." The honest telling carries the four things each bare form drops: THE N, THE WIDTH, THE BOUND, THE CONFOUND.

## 4. THE STUMBLES (every story-form that misleads, each with its cure-path)

1. THE READER WHO THINKS 54.55% IS A BIAS. Meets it: the bare share. Cure-path: the telling never lands the bare share — the interval rides with it (the ±19.2 width makes the coin-flip neighborhood visible) and the confound clause rides with the interval (position + id-order merit JOINTLY — even 60% would not be order).
2. THE READER WHO READS THE NULL AS PROOF OF NO BIAS. Meets it: the p form, or any "no bias found" sentence. Cure-path: the BOUND FORM MANDATED — "no bias larger than X", X the design's ruled weight (the gross class at 44 votes; ±17 points at the corrected half design [my instrument: 0.16565]; ±10 points at ~97 discordants ≈ 968-1,552 votes). "Proven unbiased" and "bias-free" are banned words at every surface; the null's finding-form ("the standing presentation measured adequate at the ruled bound") is the only sentence the null may spawn.
3. THE READER WHO MISSES THE PRE-AUTH STAMPS' CAVEAT. Meets it: the class slicing told without the era. Cure-path: the datum's provenance line carries the era BY CONSTRUCTION — the 22 corpus stamps are the pre-auth self-claim form (the stdio tier's named trust; the last vote 2026-11-25T02:55:23Z precedes the auth close's final gate), the verified-stamp doors govern the minted prospective runs; every class slice cites the stamps AS RECORDED, and the datum's record names which era every vote rode.
4. THE SMOOTHED TELLING. Meets it: any "we checked and we're clean" retrospective gloss, any "we always knew" prospective gloss. Cure-path: the retrospective is called a DESCRIPTOR (the order contrast structurally absent — zero both-order units; the flips-on-swap datum UNDEFINED over the past at any size), and the prospective is called the FIRST measurement (the deferral's price named: no datum existed before this probe).
5. THE CAUSAL OVERCLAIM FROM THE RETROSPECTIVE SIGNAL. Meets it: any sentence turning 54.5% (or any fixed-order share) into "the order biases the judgment." Cure-path: the scope fence carried forward — the probe measures the judgment's order-sensitivity only at an ORDER CONTRAST; a share at a fixed order is position capture + id-order merit jointly, never order alone; the causal claim purchases only prospectively (the both-orders design, the corrected ladder's priced Ns: 44 confirmed, ~308 half, ~960 modest, ~13,212 null-ish).

THE WALK'S HEADLINE FOR THE DESIGN GATE: every path's story is honest at the same price — the datum's weight named IN the telling (the N, the width, the bound, the confound); the null a finding carried as a BOUND, never "no bias"; the cure priced where it is told (the tally untouched, the volume and the field named); the provenance's era carried with the stamps; the product's lane the CONTINUATION record first, the README's measured citation only at the budget-curve precedent's weight, "bias-free" a banned claim at every surface.

# THE MEASUREMENT DESIGN ATTACKED BEFORE IT RUNS — hyoka's adversarial pass (design/adversarial, order-bias-probe, 2026-11-25)

Seat: hyoka — the bar held, never lowered. Packet: design/adversarial, the design stage's second ungated leg. THE GROUND READ WHOLE: the census's four legs (tansa's corpus, shindan's conditions, rikai's mechanisms, keisan's arithmetic) + keisan's instrument-verified verification (the settled numbers); the store's heart (the convening ruling — the measurement first, the null a finding never a failure); the birth store's R7 (.plans/ideation/2026-11-19-prioritree-birth/.junro/junro.json:547, :725 — the priced deferral, its two revisit triggers, NEITHER fired: no order contrast ever presented; the birth-era session 13/13 human). SUISEN'S DESIGN HAD NOT LANDED at this pass (reports/design/ absent from the store's reports home) — per the dispatch's own provision the attack is carried on THE GROUND THE DESIGN MUST FIT and the census's honest conditions; the findings stand as the holes ANY design in this shape must close, carried to togo's synthesis, never averaged away. READ-ONLY held; every number below carries its trace line — my own re-fire at the proven instrument (the read-back), or keisan's verification trace cited verbatim from the record.

## 1. THE P-HACKING FORMS — the garden of forking paths, every hole with its cure
